decided_by.quote: You should expect to see clear statements in assignment briefs about whether using AI is acceptable.

duty.quote: Our general principle is that the work you hand in must be your own, and where it is acceptable to make use of AI, you need to acknowledge this.

referencing.quote: If your subject uses a referencing system which does not specify how to reference AI, follow the format for citing a personal communication.
